information_flow: The first authority receives all common inputs and emits one complete executable policy without accompanying construction provenance. The final authority consumes that policy and the common external inputs, receives no predecessor rationale or intermediate state, reconciles the artifact as an indivisible whole, and emits one policy.
name: Provenance-Erased Executable Reconciliation Relay

calls.objective: Reject the inherited reversible-delta and terminal-compression family, construct one complete contract-compliant policy under the independent replacement principle, and transmit only the executable artifact without rationale, edit history, provisional states, or retained evidence.

Consume the immediately preceding executable policy as the sole lineage state, assess it as an indivisible whole against the permitted external obligations, resolve any whole-artifact incoherence without reconstructing predecessor provenance, and emit one complete contract-compliant policy.
